title.en: Negative Numbers · The World Below Zero

desc.zh: 温度计掉到 0 以下、电梯下到 B1——负数记的是「在基准的另一边、还差多少」。放上数轴一比就懂：越往左越小，所以 −3 比 −7 暖和。这一页只讲现象和比较，不背法则。
desc.en: Thermometers drop below zero and lifts go down to B1 — negative numbers record 'on the other side of the reference point, and by how much'. Put them on a number line and it clicks: further left means smaller, so −3 is warmer than −7. This page is phenomena and comparison only — no rules to memorise.
